binding_status: V3 compatibility widget source contracts. Current parent-observed purchasesXstatus DOM is V56; exact active binding to these widgets is UNKNOWN. Preload/presence is not proof use.

search.source_behavior: widget.search adds button resource BTN00113, registers F8, then on click requires header shown (plus event-list visibility guard) and delegates searchManager.executeHeader.
search.F3: No F3 literal in any new V3 header/contents/footer body. Parent current UI observes active Search F3. Current binding is not inferred from V3 F8.

report_modes_and_grouping.cmbSumFlagDate: Constants summary9,custEmailSend10,custom99. Configures grouping/target/comparison from pageInfo.aggregateInfo and pageOption.aggregateList. Summary/custom set TABLE_TYPE=dataView, otherwise grid; source control base value1 clears REPORT_CONDITION/REPORT_SORT_INDEX/TYPE/SUBTOTAL_USE/target and compare0/pivot/ratio/code false. Summary hides formList/linkSort/linkSortTotal and changes form mode.
report_modes_and_grouping.aggregationType: Constants detail1,line3,summary9,custEmailSend10. Summary9 => dataView; else grid. Non-summary uses output form ColumnSetPivot and settingInfo.typeMappings[selected radio] to construct CONDITIONS. Values other than3 or10 become99; summary always99 in the control-named search param. These are distinct widget variants and must not be merged into one universal code mapping.
report_modes_and_grouping.line_wording: line3 is explicit source constant; page-selected labels/resource translations and actual current grouping selector binding are external.

comparison.source_behavior: Comparison labels/options are supplied to external generated controls; page aggregate options and settingInfo can alter visibility/configuration. rbReportType supports pageInfo.aggregateInfo.compareResourceList override.
comparison.limits: aggregationType rejects compare selection !=string0 when output form option.isPivot is true, alerts MSG11788 and stops async step.
comparison.unknown: Exact code-to-전년/전월/전주/전일 mapping, date arithmetic, inclusive boundaries, leap/week rules, baseline and percentage computations are not defined in these wrappers. No local dates invented.

sorting.linkSort: Lazily requests /SVC/Common/Form/GetXFormDesign, opens FM053P_01. apply/save with nonempty data sets isAppliedSort and stores Mainset.Sort; pre-search writes IsAppliedSort/MainsetOutSort.
sorting.linkSortTotal: Opens FM079P_01 with form and settings permission context. apply/save receives sortData, columns, report title/page-total/body-total settings, records SUBTOT_TF/TOT_TF/STOT_SUM_USE_TF and optional left-fixed cancellation. Pre-search writes MainsetOutSort/ReportTitle/Page/Body/TabBasic and Columns. This is query/form settings, not proof of a local comparator or aggregate calculation.
sorting.reset: linkSort _reset clears application flag/form/sort and warning class. linkSortTotal also clears body/tabBasic local state; form and user-tab callbacks determine persistence.

excel.source_behavior: outputExcel checks contextual visibility/security and total_count <=100000, obtains export params from current search conditions/form, calls ecount.document.exportExcel. Uses dynamic settingInfo.getPathInfo and setExcelParam; SVC export path wraps Request.Data+CheckPermissionRequest. No exact purchase-export URL asserted.
excel.security_boundary: With permission context, requests /SVC/SelfCustomize/Config/CheckFileSecurityPolicy AuthorityType EC001 and can block. Footer button permission uses USE_EXCEL_CONVERT when not UPD; downstream checks/helpers are external. More than10000 response MaxCount triggers informational alert.
excel.unknown: Exported row scope, workbook formatting, exact server filename, current tenant export policy and successful file generation unobserved.

print.report_printHtml: Click invokes pagePrint; Ctrl+F2 also calls it. Optional security policy AuthorityType PT001, concurrent-print guard. Prints current contents getHtml, or whole layout when isConvertAllContents setting; takes output form printCss, creates hidden PrintLoadPage, callback invokes print. Visible graph can be captured/printed separately. Does not prove every server record is included.
print.slip_print_is_separate: widget.print requires checked grid rows and calls printSlip.openPrintPopup. Do not conflate report rendered HTML printing with selected slip print.
print.unknown: Browser print dialog/output, permissions, current binding to footer item, CSS/page breaks and real print success unobserved.

contents_and_headers.source_behavior: titlebar derives form title and dimensions from outputFormManager form list; contents source includes generic title/tree/barcode widgets. It does not statically declare purchasesXstatus or the observed16column definitions.
